label: Uniform local motion as a state: Uniform motion is a state like rest: a body persevering in it…
term: uniform local motion as a state
definition: Uniform motion is a state (status, état de mouvement) like rest: a body persevering in it acquires nothing and does not pass from potency to act; it only changes position, and needs an actual mover only to pass from rest to motion or to change its state (the Cartesian mechanist view as Garrigou-Lagrange reports it, 1914, p. 250). On this sense a body persevering in uniform motion is not `MovedIn` in that respect (DEF-MOTION-AS-REDUCTION). Newton's word status is compatible with this sense but does not decide it.
